correctness.rationale: For k, epsilon, delta>0 the scalar equilibrium equation has simple folds at r=±sqrt((k+3)/3) with nonzero quadratic drift and nonzero unfolding transversality; the full Jacobian has a simple zero eigenvalue and strictly left-half-plane quadratic transverse factor. Solving all center graph invariance coefficients independently yields A=−3r/H and B=(−1+2kA²S)/H, hence L=B/A. On the attracting side ru>0, the reciprocal equation W'=−A−B/W+O(W^-2) integrates to W=−At+(B/A) log t+C+o(1) because the remaining O(log t/t²) drift is integrable. Stable-fiber exponential tracking gives the same log coefficient off the strong stable manifold; strong-stable trajectories converge exponentially and are correctly excluded. For all positive k,delta the sole root epsilon*=sqrt(6k(k+3)S)−k(1+1/delta) is positive, and signs follow from monotonic H. Independent SymPy reconstructed the cubic invariance without relying on the supplied assertion; all six residuals vanish. Five numerical parameter cases corroborate, do not prove, the infinite-time law.
residual_risks: Conclusion only applies to trajectories converging to the fold from its attracting side while eventually remaining local and avoiding the local strong-stable manifold.
No global basin, mixed-mode periodic-orbit or epsilon/delta zero singular-limit theorem follows.
Finite numerical integrations are not a proof of the asymptotic or existence of stable foliations; the latter uses the smooth stable-fiber theorem in the analytical argument.

value.rationale: The ordinary equilibrium folds of the canonical Koper system bound bistable-onset regimes, and the local critical algebraic drift is physically/mathematically distinguishable from transverse exponential relaxation. Computing the exact cubic coefficient supplies a complete positive-parameter sign partition for the first logarithmic correction, including a nonempty cancellation surface depending nontrivially on BOTH finite relaxation timescales; this is a structural, motivated asymptotic boundary, not arbitrary numerical slicing or a generic textbook restatement. A researcher examining slow transients near the ordinary fold can use the precise coefficient and its vanishing locus without assuming global MMO significance.
residual_risks: This is a local model-specific asymptotic invariant rather than a general theorem on mixed-mode oscillations or global chaos.
Potential specialized prior-work coverage may reduce its originality and, through that, practical contribution; significance is not claimed to be paper-sized.
